FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Je m'appelle Amina.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. How are you?
   B. What is your name?
   C. My name is Amina.
   D. And you?

2. What does 'Et toi ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. How are you?
   B. How do you spell it?
   C. What is your name?
   D. And you?

3. What does 'Voici' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the boy
   B. the sister
   C. the father
   D. Here is

4. How do you say 'Here is my family.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.
   B. C'est mon frère.
   C. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.
   D. Voici ma famille.

5. What does 'la porte' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the ball
   B. the chair
   C. the book
   D. the door

6. What does 'Où est ... ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the book
   B. Where is ... ?
   C. the sofa
   D. the cat

7. What does 'dans' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. under
   B. behind
   C. on
   D. in

8. What does 'jeudi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Thursday
   B. Sunday
   C. Friday
   D. Tuesday

9. How do you say 'What day is it today?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   B. Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   C. Demain, c'est jeudi.
   D. Le dimanche, je me repose.

10. What does 'vendredi' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Thursday
   C. Friday
   D. Monday

11. What does 'l'eau' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. water
   B. health
   C. sweets
   D. bread

12. What does 'la carotte' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. juice
   B. the carrot
   C. vegetables
   D. cheese

13. What does 'la dent' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the tooth
   B. the arm
   C. the eyes
   D. the ear

14. How do you say 'I have a nose.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux mains.
   B. Touche ton nez !
   C. J'ai un nez.
   D. Il est grand.

15. What does 'le dos' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the foot
   B. the back
   C. the hand
   D. the eyes

16. How do you say 'Tomorrow the weather is nice.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait chaud.
   B. Demain, il fait beau.
   C. Il fait beau.
   D. Il neige.

17. What does 'à droite' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. straight ahead
   B. to the right
   C. near
   D. to the left

18. How do you say 'The door is next to the window.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le frigo est dans la cuisine.
   B. La télé est sur la table.
   C. La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.
   D. Le chat est derrière la porte.

19. What does 'Tournez' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Go
   B. Turn
   C. You are welcome
   D. Excuse me

20. What does 'Bonjour, Amina !' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello, Amina!
   B. Pleased to meet you!
   C. Yes, I am fine.
   D. I am well, thank you.

21. Which little word goes with 'grand-mère' (the grandmother)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. l'
   D. le

22. Which little word goes with 'livre' (the book)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. les
   D. l'

23. Which little word goes with 'porte' (the door)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. la

24. What does 'Demain, c'est jeudi.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Thursday, I sing.
   B. On Monday, I go to school.
   C. Tomorrow it is Thursday.
   D. On Sunday, I go to church.

25. What does 'Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. When is your birthday?
   B. My birthday is on 30 June.
   C. Thank you very much!
   D. I am ten years old.

26. Read: Aujourd'hui, c'est le 12 mai. C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina. Elle a dix ans. Il y a un gâteau et dix bougies. Question: Whose birthday is it? (1 mark)
   A. the teacher's
   B. Kamau's
   C. Njeri's
   D. Amina's

27. What does 'Je mange une mangue.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a cake.
   B. They are mangoes.
   C. It is not good for your health.
   D. I eat a mango.

28. What does 'Il est grand.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a mouth.
   B. He is tall.
   C. I have two eyes.
   D. She has black hair.

29. What does 'Elle a les cheveux noirs.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. She has black hair.
   B. I have two hands.
   C. She has long hair.
   D. Touch your nose!

30. Which little word goes with 'jambe' (the leg)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. la
   C. les
   D. l'

31. Fill in: C'est ______ lit. (1 mark)
   A. une
   B. des
   C. la
   D. un

32. How do you say 'Put' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le lit
   B. Mets
   C. le chat
   D. sous

33. How do you say 'a party' in French? (1 mark)
   A. un cadeau
   B. un ballon
   C. une fête
   D. un gâteau

34. How do you write the number 14 in French? (1 mark)
   A. vingt et un
   B. quatorze
   C. dix-huit
   D. treize

35. How do you say the month 'September' in French? (1 mark)
   A. novembre
   B. janvier
   C. septembre
   D. août

36. How do you say 'bread' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les frites
   B. la carotte
   C. le maïs
   D. le pain

37. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'shoulder'? (1 mark)
   A. èpaule
   B. épale
   C. epaule
   D. épaule

38. How do you say 'the head' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'oreille
   B. la jambe
   C. la dent
   D. la tête

39. How do you say 'It is cold.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait froid.
   B. Il fait beau.
   C. Il fait chaud.
   D. Il pleut.

40. How do you say 'It is windy.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il gèle.
   B. Il y a des nuages.
   C. Il fait beau.
   D. Il y a du vent.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Translate into French: 'Touch your nose!' (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Complete the dialogue with words from the bank: ______ ! Je ______ Amina. Et toi ? (bank: Bonjour, m'appelle) (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Write three instructions in French to tell a friend where to put things in a room. (5 marks) (5 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Elle a les cheveux longs.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Il neige.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'It is a banana.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

47. Translate into English: 'Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'And you?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

49. Translate into English: 'C'est ma mère.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

50. Translate into French: 'The weather is nice.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

51. Translate into English: 'Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

52. Write a short dialogue asking what day it is and answering. (3 marks) (3 marks)

53. Translate into French: 'Here is my grandfather.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

54. Name the four French accents you have learned and give an example word for each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

55. Write the French words for: I dance, I rest, the week (3 marks) (3 marks)

56. Translate into English: 'C'est une table.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

57. Translate into French: 'Turn right.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

58. Translate into English: 'Mets le livre sur la table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

59. Write the French words for: the hand, the back, the stomach (3 marks) (3 marks)

60. Translate into French: 'It is raining.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

61. Explain why the order le 12 mai matters and write the date the wrong way for comparison. (3 marks) (3 marks)

62. Translate into French: 'Pleased to meet you!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

63. Translate into French: 'Thank you very much!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — My name is Amina.
   Je m'appelle Amina. means My name is Amina..

2. D — And you?
   Et toi ? means And you?.

3. D — Here is
   Voici means Here is.

4. D — Voici ma famille.
   Here is my family. in French is Voici ma famille.

5. D — the door
   la porte means the door.

6. B — Where is ... ?
   Où est ... ? means Where is ... ?.

7. D — in
   dans means in.

8. A — Thursday
   jeudi means Thursday.

9. B — Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?
   What day is it today? in French is Quel jour est-ce aujourd'hui ?

10. C — Friday
   vendredi means Friday.

11. A — water
   l'eau means water.

12. B — the carrot
   la carotte means the carrot.

13. A — the tooth
   la dent means the tooth.

14. C — J'ai un nez.
   I have a nose. in French is J'ai un nez.

15. B — the back
   le dos means the back.

16. B — Demain, il fait beau.
   Tomorrow the weather is nice. in French is Demain, il fait beau.

17. B — to the right
   à droite means to the right.

18. C — La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.
   The door is next to the window. in French is La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.

19. B — Turn
   Tournez means Turn.

20. A — Hello, Amina!
   Bonjour, Amina ! means Hello, Amina!

21. B — la
   grand-mère is feminine, so we say la grand-mère.

22. A — le
   livre is masculine, so we say le livre.

23. D — la
   porte is feminine, so we say la porte.

24. C — Tomorrow it is Thursday.
   Demain, c'est jeudi. means Tomorrow it is Thursday.

25. A — When is your birthday?
   Ton anniversaire, c'est quand ? means When is your birthday?

26. D — Amina's
   C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina.

27. D — I eat a mango.
   Je mange une mangue. means I eat a mango.

28. B — He is tall.
   Il est grand. means He is tall.

29. A — She has black hair.
   Elle a les cheveux noirs. means She has black hair.

30. B — la
   jambe is feminine, so we say la jambe.

31. D — un
   Lit is masculine, so un.

32. B — Mets
   Put in French is Mets.

33. C — une fête
   a party in French is une fête.

34. B — quatorze
   14 in French is quatorze.

35. C — septembre
   September in French is septembre.

36. D — le pain
   bread in French is le pain.

37. D — épaule
   The correct spelling is épaule, with its accents.

38. D — la tête
   the head in French is la tête.

39. A — Il fait froid.
   It is cold. in French is Il fait froid..

40. D — Il y a du vent.
   It is windy. in French is Il y a du vent..
